rationale: Followed the brief's scene in the white/off-white/grey palette; light set to upper-left to match the real pack shots. Props, tints and textures kept in outer or lower areas so the copy and photo zones stay empty. Situation briefs evoke the moment without people or product.

variants.axis_value: Off-white wall, diagonal shadow, pale grey-blue floor line
variants.image_prompt: Create a photographic background image: a straight-on view of an off-white #F4F2EE wall with a faint diagonal shadow across the upper-left corner and a pale grey-blue #E5E9EA floor line at the bottom of the frame. Lighting: soft daylight from the upper left at 5600K, shadows falling to the lower right, very low contrast. Background: matte plaster wall, shallow depth. Style: clinical editorial, single light source. The left half of the frame is intentionally empty, an even low-detail field for headline copy added later. The right 45% of the frame is intentionally empty, an evenly lit open area reserved for a photo placed later. The bottom quarter of the frame stays plain and calm. Square 1:1, 1024x1024, 50mm lens at f/8 so the whole surface is sharp, fine photographic detail, no film grain. Do not include: any text, letters, numbers, logos, product, bottle, tube, packaging, people, faces, skin, hands.
variants.negative_prompt: Do not include: any text, letters, numbers, logos, product, bottle, tube, packaging, people, faces, skin, hands.

asset_requirements: real pack shot composited by the tool
